description: Parking — Occupancy forecasting is a series of datasets listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. The Brisbane City Council parking occupancy forecasting data is provided to be accessed by third party web or app developers to develop tools to provide Brisbane residents and visitors with likely parking availability within a paid parking area. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are meters, parking, transport. The portal shows 2,729,201 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
